classifier.DIVERSITY_MORE_SENSITIVE: Diversity Vote range exceeds P0 by >=0.20 or MeanMember range exceeds P0 by >=0.10
classifier.NO_MATERIAL_SENSITIVITY: both Vote ranges and Diversity MeanMember range are <=0.10
classifier.SHARED_CONTRACT_SENSITIVITY: both P0 and Diversity Vote ranges are >=0.20
